entities.name: Paulos Tzadua
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Paulos Tzadua was an Ethiopian Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Addis Abeba and head of the Ethiopian Catholic Church from 1977 to 1998. He was made the first-ever Ethiopian cardinal in 1985.
